scope: Seven original Library reports inspected and hashed locally. CI without --sources validates excerpts only, not unavailable original bytes. Full original copies accompany the local bundle.

sources.name: UQCF_GEM_v10_8_Pre_Time_Motion_Consistency_Gate.md
sources.excerpt: Motion is represented as a reversible relation between physical relational configurations.

sources.name: UQCF_GEM_v10_21_Pre_Time_Closure_Audit_Pruning_Readiness_Gate.md
sources.excerpt:
Entropy or irreversible information loss cannot be invoked to explain any theorem already
classified as pre-time.

sources.name: UQCF_GEM_v11_1_Minimal_Pruning_Primitive_Recoverability_Order_Gate.md
sources.excerpt:
This closes the minimal **nonselective** pruning primitive conditionally on accepting RAS.

It does not yet select one measurement outcome or branch.

sources.name: UQCF_GEM_v11_2_Pruning_Event_Ordered_History_Gate.md
sources.excerpt:
Conditional on RAS + RCR, compatible central-record refinement gives an intrinsic event-order
relation with no time parameter.

A realized branch is locally totally ordered, while alternative branches remain incomparable.

This gives an atemporal ordinal event history.

sources.name: UQCF_GEM_v11_3_Ordinal_Event_Time_Reparameterization_Gate.md
sources.excerpt:
A finite realized branch has an intrinsic order type and therefore an intrinsic ordinal event
position.

However, every strictly increasing real-valued labeling of that chain represents the same event
order. The theory does not select interval lengths, duration ratios, clock rate, or global
simultaneity.

sources.name: UQCF_GEM_v11_4_Intrinsic_Duration_Clock_Candidate_Gate.md
sources.excerpt:
These candidates remain inequivalent even after fixing one common clock unit.

Therefore metric duration is underdetermined by the current pruning architecture.

sources.name: UQCF_GEM_v11_5_Clock_Selection_Primitive_Dynamics_Coupling_Gate.md
sources.excerpt:
However, MCCC is a new physical bridge. It is not already implied by the frozen pre-time motion law.

Therefore metric time remains **conditional** rather than derived unconditionally.
